definitions.definition: Accurately means correctly and without mistakes.
An adventure is an exciting thing to do or a new experience.
Ago means before now, in the past.
Amazing means really wonderful and surprising.
Appropriate means suitable or fitting for the situation.
Help or support given to someone.
Assisted means helped.
Astronomical means enormous, and it also describes anything to do with stars and space.
The study of stars, planets and everything else in space.
The atmosphere is the layer of air that surrounds a planet.
Attentively means while paying close and careful attention.
To the place where something was before.
Empty, with nothing on it or covering it.
Bare and empty, with nothing on it.
To feel sure that something is true.
Where something belongs is the right place for it to be.
A bone is one of the hard parts inside an animal's body that hold it up.
Bones are the hard parts inside an animal's body that hold it up.
Sets of printed pages joined together, full of stories or facts to read.
Borrowed means taken for a while, with the promise of giving it back.
Giving out lots of light, or very colourful.
Full right up to the top.
Bulky means big, thick and hard to move about in.
Bursting means so full that it can hardly hold any more.
Full of people or things happening; having lots to do.
Cabbages are big, round, leafy green vegetables.
To call on someone is to go and visit them.
Carefully means paying close attention so that you don't miss anything.
A person who draws and makes maps.
A cave is a big hole in a hill or under the ground, often dark and bare inside.
Cheerful means happy and full of good spirits.
Clever means good at thinking and working things out.
A group of things gathered together, like books or stamps.
Enormous; very, very big.
A ball of ice and dust that zooms through space with a glowing tail.
Composed means created or put together, such as a piece of writing or music.
As a result; because of that.
Conspicuously means in a way that is very easy to notice.
A constellation is a group of stars that seems to make a shape or picture in the sky.
Constellations are groups of stars that seem to make shapes or pictures in the sky.
Calm and happy with how things are.
To do with the whole universe; here it means enormous or huge.
Countless means so many that they would be impossible to count.
Curved means bent in a smooth line, like part of a circle.
A little bit wet.
Deduction is working out an answer by thinking carefully about the clues you have.
Very pleased and happy.
To delve into something is to explore it closely and find out more.
A descent is a journey downwards, like a spacecraft coming in to land.
Even though something else is true.
A detective is someone who solves puzzles by looking carefully at clues.
Carefully and with lots of hard work.
A dinosaur is a kind of animal that lived a very, very long time ago.
Dinosaurs were animals, many of them huge, that lived on Earth millions of years ago.
A messy, disorganised state where things are not as they should be.
Discovered means found something for the first time.
Distorted means twisted out of shape so that it looks unclear or wrong.
Dominated means was the most powerful and widespread in a place.
Earth is the planet where we all live.
An egg is a round shell that a baby animal grows inside.
Eggs are round shells that some baby animals hatch out of.
Elusive means hard to find or catch.
With nothing inside.
Very excited about and interested in something.
Forever; for all time.
Exceptionally means much more than usual.
Exhilarating means thrilling and full of excitement.
An expert is someone who knows a great deal about a subject.
Extinct means gone for ever, like dinosaurs, which no longer live anywhere.
Strong trust in someone or something.
To fill a gap means to put something into the empty space.
To discover something you were looking for.
Finished means you have done all of something and there is none left to do.
Fossilised describes something that has slowly turned into stone over millions of years.
Fossils are the remains or shapes of ancient living things preserved in rock.
A wild animal like a small dog, with orange fur and a bushy tail.
A friend is someone you like and who likes you too.
A frill is a wide, curved edge, like the bony shield around a Triceratops's neck.
Frozen means turned hard and icy because it is so cold.
With no room left for anything more.
A galaxy is an enormous group of millions of stars and planets.
A gap is an empty space where something is missing.
Empty spaces between things.
A person who looks after a garden and grows plants.
Your grandad is the dad of your mum or dad.
Feeling thankful for something someone did.
Gravity is the invisible pull that draws objects towards each other, like planets towards the sun.
To get bigger over time.
Feeling more happy than before.
Feeling good and cheerful.
A hatchling is a baby animal that has just come out of its egg.
A helmet is a strong hat that keeps your head safe.
Help means doing something useful to make things easier for someone.
A herbivore is an animal that eats only plants.
Herbivores are animals that eat only plants.
A raised piece of land, smaller than a mountain.
The place where someone or something belongs.
To want something to happen and believe it might.
Horns are hard, pointed parts that grow on some animals' heads.
A house is a building that people live in.
Humans are people, like you and me.
Moved or did something quickly.
A hypothesis is an idea that someone suggests to explain something, which can then be tested.
Illustrated means filled with pictures or drawings that help explain the words.
Impressive means so good that people notice and admire it.
Ingenuity is the clever, inventive way someone solves a problem.
Intact means whole and undamaged, with nothing missing.
Asked to come somewhere or join in.
Jubilant means full of joy, especially because something has gone well.
Jupiter is the biggest planet in our solar system.
Alike in some way, as if part of the same family.
Came down and arrived safely, like a spaceship touching the ground.
Bigger than something else.
Largest means the biggest of all.
Launched means sent up into the air or into space.
A person who looks after a library and helps people find books.
A place full of books that people can borrow and read.
A tall tower with a bright light that guides ships at night.
Lived means stayed and made a home somewhere in the past.
Here, lonely means looking empty, with nothing else around.
Gone, and you don't know where it is.
Lumbering means moving slowly and heavily, in a clumsy way.
Luminous means glowing or giving off light.
The word you use when you talk about yourself.
Wandering slowly with lots of twists and turns.
A meteor is a small piece of rock flying very fast through space.
Meticulous means very careful and paying close attention to every detail.
Extremely small; tiny.
Not where it should be; lost.
An important task or job that someone has been given to do.
Monumental means very large or important, like a huge achievement.
The big round thing that shines in the sky at night.
The neck is the part of the body that joins the head to the rest of the body.
Nicely means in a good or pleasing way.
Night is the dark time when the sun has gone down.
The night sky is the dark sky you see after sunset, full of stars and the moon.
Watching something carefully to learn about it.
An orbit is the curved path something follows as it travels around a planet or star.
Orbiting means travelling around a planet or star in a curved path, again and again.
The dark, mostly empty area far beyond Earth's sky.
A saying that means extremely happy.
So full that there is hardly any room left.
A palaeontologist is a scientist who studies fossils to learn about ancient life.
Palaeontology is the science of studying fossils to learn about ancient life, such as dinosaurs.
Shapes or events that repeat in a regular way.
Keeping going even when something is hard.
To keep trying even when something is difficult.
A planet is a huge round world that travels around a star, like Earth or Mars.
Planets are huge round worlds that travel around a star, like Earth does around the Sun.
A small area of still water.
Pondering means thinking about something slowly and carefully.
Liked by lots of people.
Being liked or enjoyed by lots of people.
Being exact and very careful.
A predator is an animal that hunts other animals for food.
A difficult or tricky situation.
Prehistoric means from the very distant past, before people wrote anything down.
Something that is wrong and needs fixing.
To propagate means to spread or travel from one place to another.
A big round orange vegetable that grows on a vine.
To move something away from you using your hands or body.
Questions are things you ask when you want to find out an answer.
The moment a spacecraft comes back into Earth's air; here it means the books returning home.
To read is to look at words and understand what they say.
A person who reads.
Recalibrated means carefully adjusted an instrument so it works accurately again.
Something that reflects light bounces it back, like a mirror does.
A relative is someone who belongs to the same family, even if they are only distantly related.
Repeating means happening again in the same way as before.
Replenished means filled up again after being empty.
To come back and tell someone what has happened.
Put back to how it was before.
To go and get something back.
To give or bring something back.
Gave or brought something back.
Riddles are puzzles that describe something in a clever way so you have to guess what it is.
To roar is to make a very loud, deep sound, like a lion or a dinosaur.
A rock is a hard piece of stone.
A rocket is a machine that flies very fast up into space.
Something round is shaped like a ball or a circle.
Rusty means a reddish-brown colour, like old metal that has been left out in the rain.
Protected from harm or danger.
Spread out in lots of different places.
Scientists are people who study the world carefully to find out how things work.
To look carefully for something.
Looking carefully for something.
To notice something with your eyes.
To look for someone or something.
To shine means to give out bright light.
A shooting star is a streak of light made when a tiny bit of space rock burns up in the sky.
The sky is the space above you where you see the sun, moon and stars.
The earth that plants grow in.
A hot, runny food made by cooking vegetables or meat in water.
Space is the huge area far above the sky, where the stars and planets are.
Thinly spread out, with lots of empty space.
A star is a huge ball of hot, glowing gas in space, like our sun.
To stargaze means to spend time looking up at the stars and planets.
Stargazing is spending time looking up at the stars and studying the night sky.
Stars are the tiny bright lights you see in the sky at night.
Stellar means excellent, and it also means to do with the stars.
To stomp is to walk with big, heavy, noisy steps.
Tales about people and events, real or made up.
To suggest here means to give evidence that something is likely to be true.
A tail is the long part at the back of an animal's body.
To say words out loud to someone.
Teeth are the hard white parts in a mouth used for biting and chewing.
To say something to someone so they know it.
What you say to show you are grateful.
Thrilled means very happy and excited.
Thundering means moving with a loud, rumbling noise, like thunder.
A trackway is a long line of footprints left by animals as they walked.
Very dangerous, especially when it doesn't look it.
A space with nothing in it at all, not even air.
To disappear suddenly.
Disappeared suddenly.
To visit someone is to go and see them.
The void is a huge, empty space, here meaning the emptiness of outer space.
Books, especially big books or books in a set.
Walking slowly with no special place to go.
Warm means a little bit hot, in a nice, cosy way.
Weightlessness is the feeling of having no weight, so you float instead of staying on the floor.
What you say to praise someone who did something good.
Groups of letters that mean something when you read or say them.
A year is the time it takes Earth to travel once around the Sun, about 365 days.
Yet is a linking word that means 'but' and shows something surprising.
To zoom means to move very fast.
